label:
<think>
The compilation error arises from the Jakarta EE namespace change in jakarta.mvc-api 2.x, where all javax.mvc.* packages were moved to jakarta.mvc.*. In the client code, MvcBinding is still imported from javax.mvc.binding, causing the compiler to not find the class. The fix is to update the import to jakarta.mvc.binding.MvcBinding. The @MvcBinding annotations remain valid. Other imports (javax.validation and javax.ws.rs) are untouched as the reported error is specific to mvc; making broader changes could introduce unintended issues if other dependencies haven't migrated.
</think>
